== Course of events ==

With the Tin Woodman having bound two sofas together as a body and fixed the Gump's head to the front, Tip recites the magic words he once learned from Old Mombi. At his command, the Thing comes to life, screeching and flapping its wings violently. In the moments that follow, a sudden wind nearly sends several of the assembled travelers tumbling from the roof, though each is saved, and the newly animated Thing rises into the air of its own accord. Tip then commands the Gump to return, and, its head now alive, it obeys and lands safely back upon the roof.

In the aftermath, Tip grows anxious over how much of Mombi's magic powder remains, weighing whether to use what is left to animate the head or the legs of the sofas that make up the Thing's body.
